goal: Memory recall accuracy review: whether the right memory comes back, and stale facts do not.
use: Memory recall accuracy review: whether the right memory comes back, and stale facts do not. Use when an agent retrieves stored memory for a new task.

steps.note: Pick test questions. Write questions whose answers are in memory.
Run recall. Check whether each answer comes back.
Check stale facts. Flag memories that were true once and are no longer.
Check conflicts. Flag two memories that disagree and which one wins.
Report. Recall rate, the misses, the stale items and the fix.
